overclaims: Treating millions of seats as decisive would repeat the reviewers' objection.
checks.note: The statement excerpt is exact, and the axis, horizon and unresolved outcome match the reviews. The final rationale sentence cites an internal reviewers' objection that readers cannot see and the evidence does not support. Two cited excerpts are cut so their subject is missing. e1 reads 'increased over 7X year-over-year' without saying it was customers with more than 50,000 seats. e2 reads '42.4%, remaining the leader...' without naming Anthropic. Both are misleading out of context.
